text:
marie (Finance): Invoice 2034 for Skyline Corp is 45 days past due — ACH returned (R01) this morning. Bank note: account closed. attaching invoice link: https://redwood.ai/invoices/2034
eli (Collections): Noted. I called the bank; return matches 'account closed'. Reached out to AM. @jess any commitment from Skyline?
jess (Sales): Spoke with their CFO yesterday. They asked to split into 2 payments. Can do 50% today via card, remainder next month. They asked to waive the late fee if we accept.
marie (Finance): We can consider staged payment. Terms: 50% now, 50% net30; waive late fee if they sign a payment plan agreement. Need written approval or PO. Can they provide card auth today?
sara-cs (CS): I'll send the payment link and try to capture card auth this afternoon. @billing-bot can you spin up split invoices and links?
billing-bot: Generated invoices: 2034-1 (50%) and 2034-2 (50%). Payment links: https://pay.redwood.ai/pay/2034-1 and https://pay.redwood.ai/pay/2034-2. Late fee waived pending signed plan. Links expire in 7 days.
jess (Sales): Forwarded both links to CFO, they want the 7-day expiry. Also asked us to pause service suspension until second installment is due. Thoughts?
eli (Collections): Pause suspension OK if first payment captures today and second installment is contractually locked + card on file. Need manager sign-off for hold. @marie can you approve the account hold until net30?
marie (Finance): Approve temporary hold contingent on capture of the first payment and signed agreement. Please add contract note and set a reminder 5 days before second due date.
jess (Sales): CFO emailed a one-line confirmation: "We agree to 50/50 plan, will pay first today by card." Attached email saved to the account.
eli (Collections): I'll update account status to 'staged-plan' and schedule follow-ups. If card declines, escalate to legal.
sara-cs (CS): :thumbsup: processing payment now.
billing-bot: Payment captured: $125,000 (2034-1) at 2167002000. Reminder set for second installment on 2167004876.
marie (Finance): Good. I'll issue a credit memo for the waived late fee ($2,500) and send confirmation to Skyline finance. Closing loop unless issues arise.
eli (Collections): Thanks all — tracking in collections board under "Skyline Corp - staged plan" and tagging legal for visibility.
